notes: Validated against Kulshina N et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2009 (doi:10.1038/nsmb.1561). GEMM-II c-di-GMP riboswitch from V. cholerae. Chain R, C2E at R:1. Both guanine bases of c-di-GMP stack on receptor bases; phosphodiester backbone contacts R:72-74. 4 Mg2+ ions in chain R removed per benchmark ion policy. GTP R:8 (5' terminal nucleotide) included in receptor. Companion to 3IRW (GEMM-I type I) — same cyclic dinucleotide ligand, different RNA fold.
